title: [3.1.0.3-dev-d] Going back in preferences opens all tabs
body:
When in three-dots-menu under preferences and you click on any option (no matter if sub-menu or single option) and then going back unfolds all tabs at once.

For example:
General -> Language.
Then back-gesture will quit dialog and unfold all tabs.
Also happens when "cancel" is clicked.

Version: 3.1.0.3-dev-d
Phone: Pixel 7 Pro
OS: Android 13 Build TQ1A.221205.011

comments.body: this is fully under android control. No way to change behavior
